live_evidence.postgrest_error_reproduced: PGRST102: All object keys must match

fix: services/gateway/src/services/operator-threads.ts: tool_name: null added to user/assistant message objects in recordOperatorTurn()

verification.mutation_result: reverting the fix fails the exact assertion the real bug broke (recorded:false vs expected true)
verification.fake_hardened: installFakeRest's operator_messages POST handler now emulates real PostgREST's same-object-keys bulk-insert constraint
